Subject: Docs quickstart — request for technical demo

Hi Marissa,

I followed the docs/quickstart guide and spun up a small prototype to test Redwood in our infra. We're a small platform team at Acme Analytics (3 engineers working on embedding search + retrieval). The quickstart looked great — we'd like a technical demo to cover:

- API integration patterns (streaming + function calling)
- Deployment options (Dedicated vs Private) for PII workloads
- Recommendations for batching/cost optimizations

Would you have 45–60 minutes available next week for a deep dive? We're in Pacific Time (PDT).

A few background notes: we have some on-prem components and want to understand network/VM sizing and KMS options. Happy to drop a short infra diagram if that helps.

Thanks,
Samuel Nguyen
Senior Platform Engineer
